```{r Load packages and Data}
rm(list = ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(glmmTMB)
library(lubridate)
library(data.table)
library(doBy)
library(ggeffects)
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)
library(brglm)
library(scales)

#Setting up main datasets
metadata <- read.csv("data/Main_herring_fishery_2024 - Metadata.csv", na.strings = "") %>%
  mutate(Cloud_cover = ifelse(
      Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "cloudy" |
        Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "Cloudy" |
        Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "overcast" |
        Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "Overcast" |
        Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "Rain",
      "Cloudy",
      ifelse(
        Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "clear" |
          Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "no cloud" |
          Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "Clear" |
          Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "sunny" |
          Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "Sunny",
        "Clear",
        ifelse(Prevailing_weather_cond == "Unknown", NA, "Cloudy")
      )
  )) %>%
  mutate(Fog = ifelse(
      Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "fog" == TRUE |
        Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "Fog" == TRUE,
      "Fog",
      "NoFog"
    )) %>%
  mutate(Rain = ifelse(
      Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "rain" |
        Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "Rain",
      "Rain",
      "NoRain"
    )) %>%
  mutate(Ocean_cond = ifelse(
      Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "calm" |
        Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "Calm",
      "Calm",
      ifelse(
        Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "rough" |
          Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "choppy" |
          Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "lop" |
          Prevailing_weather_cond %like% "swell",
        "Rough",
        NA
      )
    )) %>%
  mutate(Wind = ifelse(Wind_speed < 12, "LowWind", "Windy")) %>%
  drop_na(Observers, Wind) %>%
  mutate_at(c("Port", "Trip_ID", "Soak_duration", "Wind_direction_set", "Wind_direction", "Cloud_cover", "Fog", "Rain", "Ocean_cond", "Wind"), as.factor)

#Herring morphometrics data
morpho.data <- read.csv("data/Main_herring_fishery_2024 - Herring_sampling.csv", na.strings = "NA") %>%
  drop_na()

#Catch data
main.data <- read.csv("data/Main_herring_fishery_2024 - Bird_catch_BothSites2.csv",
                      na.strings = "NA") %>%
  mutate(Port = as.factor(ifelse(Trip_ID %like% "BdV", "BdV", "MH"))) %>%
  mutate(Total_catch_number = as.numeric(Total_catch_number)) %>%
  mutate(Total_catch_wt_kg =
           as.numeric(ifelse(
             is.na(Total_catch_wt_kg) == T & Port == "BdV",
             (Total_catch_number * 271) / 1000,
             Total_catch_wt_kg
           ))) %>%
  mutate(Time_setting = as.POSIXct(Time_setting, format = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S")) %>%
  mutate(Time_pulling = as.POSIXct(Time_pulling, format = "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S")) %>%
  mutate(yDate = yday(Time_pulling)) %>%
  mutate(Soak_duration = as.numeric(Time_pulling - Time_setting)) %>%
  mutate_at(6:34, as.numeric) %>%
  mutate(Birds = rowSums(.[16:33])) %>%
  mutate(Birds = ifelse(Trip_ID == "BdV_00" |
                          Trip_ID == "BdV_16", NA, Birds)) %>%
  mutate(bycatch_sum = rowSums(.[12:15])) %>%
  mutate(BirdTime = as.factor(ifelse((as.ITime(Time_pulling) < 43200) == TRUE, 
                                     "Morning", "Afternoon"
  ))) %>%
  left_join(
    metadata %>% dplyr::select(
      Trip_ID,
      Weather,
      SST_Celcius,
      Wind_speed,
      Wind_direction,
      Cloud_cover,
      Fog,
      Rain,
      Ocean_cond
    )
  )

#Subset
sum.data <- main.data %>%
  filter(!(Trip_ID %like% "MH_05" & Net_group == "b")) %>%
  filter(!(Trip_ID %like% "MH_09" & Net_group == "b")) %>%
  group_by(
    Port,
    Trip_ID,
    Net_treatment,
    yDate,
    BirdTime,
    Weather,
    Cloud_cover,
    Fog,
    Rain,
    Ocean_cond,
    Wind_direction
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    SST = sum(SST_Celcius, na.rm = T),
    WindSpeed = mean(Wind_speed, na.rm = T),
    Total_target_catch_number = sum(Total_catch_number, na.rm = T),
    Total_target_catch_kg = sum(Total_catch_wt_kg, na.rm = T),
    Net_area_m2 = sum(Total_net_area_m2, na.rm = T),
    Soak_duration = mean(Soak_duration, na.rm = T),
    Birds = sum(Birds, na.rm = T),
    bycatch_sum = sum(bycatch_sum, na.rm = T)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(WindSpeed = as.numeric(gsub("NaN", NA, WindSpeed))) %>%
  mutate(bycatch = ifelse(bycatch_sum > 0, 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(bycatch_rate = as.numeric(bycatch_sum / Soak_duration / Net_area_m2)) %>%
  mutate(scaled_weight = as.numeric(Total_target_catch_kg / Net_area_m2)) %>%
  mutate(catch_rate = as.numeric(Total_target_catch_kg / Net_area_m2 / Soak_duration)) %>%
  mutate(Net_treatment = factor(Net_treatment, levels = c("24h", "12_night", "12_day"))) %>%
  mutate(Birds = as.numeric(ifelse(Trip_ID == "BdV_00" |
                          Trip_ID == "BdV_16", NA, Birds))) %>%
  mutate(BycatchSpecies = as.factor(ifelse(Trip_ID == "MH_15", "Birds", "Fish")))
```

```{r Summary Stats}
table(sum.data$Net_treatment, sum.data$Port)

summaryBy(Soak_duration ~ Net_treatment, data = sum.data, FUN = c(length, mean, sd, min, max))

#Herring Catch summary (Table S1)
summaryBy(Total_target_catch_number ~ Net_treatment + Port, data = sum.data)
summaryBy(Total_target_catch_kg ~ Net_treatment + Port, data = sum.data)
summaryBy(Sample_herring_wt_g ~ Net_treatment + Port, data = morpho.data)
summaryBy(Sample_herring_FK_cm ~ Net_treatment + Port, data = morpho.data)

#Bird Sightings summary (Table S3)

```

```{r Catch Model}
#Check assumptions for Catch weight
jpeg(filename = "figures/CatchBoxplots.jpeg", width = 16, height = 10, units = "cm", res = 300)
ggplot(sum.data, aes(x = Net_treatment, y = scaled_weight)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("red", "blue")) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgrey", outliers = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = Port)) +
  labs(x = "Soak Treatment", y = bquote("Scaled Target Catch Weight " ~(kg/m^2))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c('Control','Reduced Night','Reduced Day')) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
dev.off()

#Clearly not normal, does contain 0s so Gamma not an option
hist(sum.data$scaled_weight)

#Get summary stats
summaryBy(scaled_weight ~ Net_treatment, data = sum.data, FUN = c(mean, median, sd))

#try model with Tweedie distribution
mod <- glmmTMB(scaled_weight ~ Net_treatment + Port + (1|yDate), data = sum.data,
                family = tweedie(link = "log"))

#check model assumptions
sim1 <- simulateResiduals(mod, plot = T)
performance::check_collinearity(mod)
plotResiduals(sim1, form = sum.data$Net_treatment)
plotResiduals(sim1, form = sum.data$Port)
plotResiduals(sim1, form = sum.data$yDate)

#assumptions looks good, get model results
summary(mod)
Anova(mod)

#Post-hoc test
emmeans(mod, list(pairwise ~ Net_treatment), adjust = "bh")
```

```{r Catch Rate Model}
#Check assumptions for Catch weight
jpeg(filename = "figures/ScaledCatchBoxplots.jpeg", width = 16, height = 10, units = "cm", res = 300)
ggplot(sum.data, aes(x = Net_treatment, y = catch_rate)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("red", "blue")) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgrey", outliers = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = Port)) +
  labs(x = "Soak Treatment", y = bquote("Scaled Target Catch Weight " ~(kg/m^2/h))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c('Control','Reduced Night','Reduced Day')) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
dev.off()

#Clearly not normal, does contain 0s so Gamma not an option
hist(sum.data$catch_rate)

#Get summary stats
summaryBy(catch_rate ~ Net_treatment, data = sum.data, FUN = c(mean, median, sd))

#try model with Tweedie distribution
mod1 <- glmmTMB(catch_rate ~ Net_treatment + Port + (1|yDate), data = sum.data,
                family = tweedie(link = "log"))

#check model assumptions
sim1.1 <- simulateResiduals(mod1, plot = T)
performance::check_collinearity(mod1)
plotResiduals(sim1.1, form = sum.data$Net_treatment)
plotResiduals(sim1.1, form = sum.data$Port)
plotResiduals(sim1.1, form = sum.data$yDate)

#assumptions looks good, get model results
summary(mod1)
Anova(mod1)

#Post-hoc test
emmeans(mod1, list(pairwise ~ Net_treatment), adjust = "bh")
```

```{r Bycatch Data}
summaryBy(bycatch_sum ~ Net_treatment, data = sum.data %>% drop_na(bycatch_sum), FUN = c(mean, sum, length))

#separating out the birds from the fish

bycatch_box <- ggplot(
  data = sum.data %>%
    mutate(bycatch_sum = ifelse(BycatchSpecies == "Birds", 3, bycatch_sum)) %>%
    add_row(
      Port = "MH",
      Trip_ID = "MH_15",
      Net_treatment = "24h",
      yDate = 148,
      bycatch_sum = 1,
      BycatchSpecies = "Fish"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Net_treatment = factor(Net_treatment, levels = c("24h", "12_night", "12_day"))),
  aes(x = Net_treatment, y = bycatch_sum)
) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgrey", outliers = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(colour = Port, pch = BycatchSpecies),
    width = 0.3,
    height = 0,
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  ylab("Bycatch (Number of Individuals)") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c('Control', 'Reduced Night', 'Reduced Day')) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("red", "blue")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(2, 1), name = "Species") +
  xlab("Soak Treatment") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

bycatchRate_line <- ggplot(
  data = sum.data %>%
    mutate(bycatch_sum = ifelse(BycatchSpecies == "Birds", 3, bycatch_sum)) %>%
    mutate(bycatch_rate = ifelse(BycatchSpecies == "Birds", 3/682.777/36, bycatch_rate)) %>%
    add_row(
      Port = "MH",
      Trip_ID = "MH_15",
      Net_treatment = "24h",
      yDate = 148,
      Soak_duration = 36,
      bycatch_sum = 1,
      BycatchSpecies = "Fish",
      bycatch_rate = 1/682.2777/36
    ) %>%
    mutate(Net_treatment = factor(
      Net_treatment, levels = c("24h", "12_night", "12_day")
    )),
  aes(x = Soak_duration, y = bycatch_rate)
) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", colour = "black") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("red", "blue")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(2, 1), name = "Species") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Port, pch = BycatchSpecies), size = 2.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Soak Duration (h)") +
  ylab(bquote(Bycatch ~ Rate ~ (Individuals / m^2 / h))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(sum.data$bycatch_rate))) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

jpeg(filename = "figures/Bycatch.jpeg", width = 16, height = 18, units = "cm", res = 300)
bycatch_box / bycatchRate_line + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") + plot_layout(guides = "collect") & theme(legend.position = "bottom")
dev.off()
```

```{r Bird Occurrence Fig}
phen <- read.csv("data/SeabirdPhenology.csv") %>%
  mutate(BreedingPhase = factor(BreedingPhase, levels = c("Pre-laying", "Incubation", "Chick-rearing", "Fledging", "Overwinter"))) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = c("Eiders", "Shearwaters", "Gulls", "NOGA", "BLKI", "COMU", "ATPU"))) %>%
  mutate(x = as.POSIXct(x), xend = as.POSIXct(xend))

ggplot() +
  scale_colour_viridis(option = "D", discrete = TRUE, direction = -1, name = "Breeding Phase") +
  scale_x_datetime(labels = date_format("%b"), date_breaks = "1 month", name = "Month") +

  geom_segment(data = phen, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = Species, yend = Species, colour = BreedingPhase), linewidth = 3) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r Bird Occurrence Model}
jpeg(filename = "figures/BirdsBoxplot.jpeg", width = 16, height = 10, units = "cm", res = 300)
ggplot(data = sum.data %>% drop_na(Birds), aes(x = BirdTime, y = Birds)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgrey") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("red", "blue")) +
  xlab("Timing of Haul and Resetting") +
  ylab("Number of Birds") +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = Port)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
dev.off()

summaryBy(Birds ~ BirdTime + Port, data = sum.data %>% drop_na(Birds), FUN = c(mean, median, sd, length))

birdmod1 <- glmmTMB(Birds ~ BirdTime + Port + WindSpeed + Fog + scaled_weight + (1|yDate), 
                    data = sum.data, 
                    family = nbinom2(link = "log"))

ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = sum.data, aes(x = Ocean_cond, y = WindSpeed)) +
  theme_classic()

birdmod2 <- glmmTMB(Birds ~ BirdTime + Port + yDate + Weather, 
                    data = sum.data %>% drop_na(Weather), 
                   family = nbinom2(link = "log"))
birdmod3 <- glmmTMB(Birds ~ BirdTime + Port + yDate + scaled_weight, 
                    data = sum.data %>% drop_na(Weather), 
                    family = nbinom2(link = "log"))
birdmod4 <- glmmTMB(Birds ~ BirdTime + Port + yDate, 
                    data = sum.data %>% drop_na(Weather), 
                    family = nbinom2(link = "log"))
anova(birdmod1, birdmod2, birdmod3, birdmod4)
anova(birdmod2, birdmod3, birdmod4)
anova(birdmod2, birdmod4)
anova(birdmod3, birdmod4)
simulateResiduals(birdmod1, plot = T)
performance::check_collinearity(birdmod1)
summary(birdmod1)
Anova(birdmod1)
```

```{r Random Forest - Weather}
library(caTools)
library(randomForest)

split <- sample.split(as.data.frame(sum.data), SplitRatio = 0.7)
train <- subset(as.data.frame(sum.data), split == "TRUE") %>%
  drop_na(Wind_direction) %>%
  mutate(Weather = as.factor(Weather)) %>%
  select(Weather, Cloud_cover,Fog,Rain,Ocean_cond,Wind_direction, WindSpeed)
test <- subset(as.data.frame(sum.data), split == "FALSE") %>%
  drop_na(Wind_direction) %>%
  mutate(Weather = as.factor(Weather)) %>%
  select(Weather, Cloud_cover,Fog,Rain,Ocean_cond,Wind_direction, WindSpeed)

set.seed(120)
classifier_RF = randomForest(x = train[-1], 
                             y = train$Weather, 
                             ntree = 500)
classifier_RF
plot(classifier_RF)

y_pred = predict(classifier_RF, newdata = test[-1])

confusion_mtx = table(test[,1], y_pred)
confusion_mtx

importance(classifier_RF)

varImpPlot(classifier_RF)
```
